flash_251362.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Shabbat and the the holidays of Shmini Atzeret and Simchat Torah in North America, where they are being written now.

Updates will resume Saturday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Shabbat, Shmini Atzeret and Simchat Torah at 18:58 Jerusalem time.

Shabbat Shalom and Chag Sameach!

flash_694672.description:
US senators secure a vote on Trump’s proposed Saudi nuclear pact, with concerns over uranium enrichment and its potential impact on regional proliferation.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Simchat Torah and Shmini Atzeret in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_694671.description:
B’nai Brith Canada says neo-Nazi flyers were distributed around Belleville, including outside the synagogue targeted in a Yom Kippur shooting.

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Simchat Torah and Shmini Atzeret in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_694680.description: Ambassador Huckabee thanked Yaniv Hayoun, the Israeli plumber who helped to stabilize the Flydubai plane, and presented him with a signed cap from President Trump.

flash_694679.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu calls Indian flydubai captain Smit Machchhar, praising him as 'hero to Israel, India, and the entire world,' and extending special Independence Day invitation.

flash_694678.description: Three years after she was kidnapped to Gaza during the October 7 massacre, former hostage Emily Damari shares disturbing photos from Shifa Hospital in Gaza, recalling her untreated wounds, terrifying captivity, and the miracle of her survival.

flash_694676.description: Two Iranian nationals were arrested in the UK over an alleged plot to attack Manchester's Jewish community during Yom Kippur.

flash_694674.description: IDF eliminates two senior Islamic Jihad terrorists near Gaza City, after they worked to rebuild the group's military capabilities in violation of the ceasefire.

flash_694696.description: Yeshiva students sing and pray at Sheba Medical Center; Rosh Yehudi organization holds 'second hakafot' in Tel Aviv. Watch.

flash_694695.description: Hapoel Tel Aviv blew a double-digit lead before a clutch three-pointer and missed free throws helped them block Ness Ziona 88-86 and reach the Winner Cup final.

flash_694693.description: Survivors of the massacre at the Nova music festival on October 7 dance with their families at an event organized by the 'Kesher Yehudi' organization. Watch.

flash_694691.description: Attendees sing and dance emotionally at site where hundreds of young people were murdered at a music festival during the October 7 massacre, exactly three years ago.

flash_694689.description: The plane was trying to exercise its ancient rights of self-determination by creating facts on the ground.

flash_694687.description: Jerusalem Mayor Moshe Lion attends post-Simchat Torah 'second hakafot' at Machon Meir.

flash_694685.description: Jewish groups hail California law making it the first state to list ‘Jewish’ as an ethnicity.

flash_694683.description: New details emerge about the Omani co-pilot accused of attacking the captain and trying to seize control of a Flydubai flight, including his past employment, alleged radicalization and social media activity.

flash_694681.description: Indian pilot Smit Machchhar tells Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu how his Omani co-pilot prayed before launching a violent attack in the cockpit, leaving him barely able to see as the plane plunged.

flash_694677.description: US President Donald Trump posted a video in which he praised Yaniv, the Israeli plumber who helped save the Flydubai plane.

flash_694675.description: Dubai's Crown Prince visits injured flydubai captain in the hospital, praising his courage after he helped save 174 passengers.

flash_694694.description: Democrats chair Yair Golan's proposal to include Ra'am in future coalition sparks disagreement with Yisrael Beytenu chairman, who rules out joining Arab parties in government.

flash_694690.description: Four protesters detained in Samaria on suspicion of disturbing public order and entering a closed military zone have been transferred for a hearing on possible expulsion from Israel.

flash_694688.description: Pro-Palestinian students in London are planning a march in support of Palestinians specifically on October 7.

flash_694684.description: Yashar! chairman Gadi Eisenkot joins post-holiday celebrations at Orot Shaul Yeshiva, where Rabbi Tamir Granot honors the memory of their sons, both of whom fell during the war.

flash_694682.description: Tehran’s maritime squeeze, Washington’s midterm political clock, and the rejection of Iran’s ceasefire offer have pushed the Strait of Hormuz to the brink. Navigating this standoff requires clear-eyed analysis of real operational limits, Arab diplomatic realities, and exact intelligence options. Opinion.

flash_694673.description: Five killed in strike on Gaza City building as IDF targets Ali al-Amoudi, a senior Hamas terrorist who has risen to prominence since Hamas leader Yahya Sinwar's elimination.

flash_694713.description: Terrorist organization behind the 9/11 attacks praises Omani hijacker, calls for others to hijack planes to attack the US and Israel.

flash_694712.description: The powerful impact caused significant damage to parts of the sukkah’s roof structure.

flash_694711.description: Israeli Mossad agents and aviation experts have joined the UAE investigation into an alleged terror plot in which a flydubai co-pilot reportedly planned to seize control of the aircraft and crash it into Tel Aviv's Azrieli Towers.

flash_694709.description: At 102, Walter Bingham danced with a child nearly a century younger during Simchat Torah in Jerusalem, recalling a childhood when Nazi persecution forced Jewish celebrations underground.

flash_694707.description: Global life expectancy returns to 73.3 years, nearly back to pre-COVID levels, but healthy life expectancy still lags behind. WHO reveals sharp rise in dementia, depression and anxiety, and increasing dominance of chronic diseases.

flash_694705.description: Yoseph Haddad, No. 2 on Amcha Yisrael's party list, said five years ago that he supports a two-state solution and peace with 'our Palestinian brothers.' Haddad: 'Enough with the spins and lies.'

flash_694703.description: Plane was trying to exercise its right of self-determination by creating facts on the ground. Satire.

flash_694701.description: Channel 13 report reveals footage from battles at Black Arrow and Mefalsim Junction, where dozens of terrorists fired at drivers and Nova survivors, and delayed arrival of rescue forces.

flash_694699.description: The Defense Ministry and National Insurance Institute publish data on casualties and victims of the 'War of Redemption.'

flash_694692.description: Three years after October 7, Avi Marciano releases a recording of his daughter Noa, who was murdered in Gaza, filmed after just four days of captivity.

flash_694686.description: Misgav Regional Council warns residents to remain indoors during planned Arab demonstrations, at the expense of holiday celebrations.

flash_694729.description: The UK Green Party conference approved a proposal defining Zionism as a 'racist ideology preferring ethnic group at the expense of others.'

flash_694728.description: During a visit to Ashdod Naval Base, Netanyahu pledged to expand Israel’s naval capabilities and warned against threats to its ports and maritime traffic.

flash_694727.description: The order signed by the Finance Minister following an agreement with the prime minister reduces the fuel excise tax, so that the price of 95-octane gasoline will fall from 8.27 shekels to 7.77 shekels per liter.

flash_694725.description: Rabbi Avihud Schwartz, head of the halakha division in the IDF Rabbinate, tells Arutz Sheva about the unbearable scenes, agonizing identifications, and emotional encounters with families that have stayed with him since October 7.

flash_694723.description: CBS News reports an initial Israeli probe points to a lone attacker, while investigators continue examining the copilot’s background and possible outside ties.

flash_694721.description: Western policy makers’ infatuation with the proposed Palestinian Arab state has been driven by Western preoccupation with the moderate Palestinian Arab talk, which is aimed at Western target audiences. Middle East Arab rulers are not impressed. Opinion.

flash_694719.description: From 'They’re right outside the door' to the final words before being abducted, victims and survivors are publishing their messages from the October 7 massacre.

flash_694717.description: A senior Channel 14 figure sharply criticized Likud and Minister Bezalel Smotrich in an unusual column over their responses to reports concerning Yoseph Haddad.

flash_694715.description:
The Ministry of Health has announced that a suspected Ebola case has been tested in Israel, after a person who returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo developed a fever upon his return. The ministry emphasizes that, at this stage, this is only a suspicion, and the test results are expected to be received today.

The person was transferred to Sheba Medical Center and is being treated in isolation according to procedures. At the same time, an epidemiological investigation is being conducted to locate people who came into contact with him. Anyone who does not receive a call from the Ministry of Health is not required to take action.

flash_694710.description: A suspect who stole a vehicle from Mevaseret Zion attempted to break through the Al-Jib crossing near Givat Ze’ev, was stopped by the security barriers, and was arrested after fleeing the scene on foot.

flash_694708.description: Of the orphans, 345; more than 2,000 people in Israel have lost a brother or sister. 1,204 parents have lost their children.

flash_694706.description: The opposition leader attacked the government following the attempted hijacking, arguing that its senior officials are shirking responsibility.

flash_694704.description: An internal National Security Council document reveals that the Transportation Ministry failed to fulfill its responsibilities despite warnings and strong opposition from professional officials.

flash_694700.description: As part of the investigation into the attempted terrorist attack on the Flydubai flight, authorities in the United Arab Emirates are investigating whether the suspected terrorist received assistance from a member of the crew.

flash_694744.description: Explosions were heard this evening in the Strait of Hormuz area. According to initial reports, the explosions were apparently caused by missiles fired from Iran at ships passing through the strait.

flash_694743.description: The erasure of Jews and treating them as villains cannot be ignored. The post-Oct. 7 surge of antisemitism is not a misunderstanding that will fade whether Netanyahu wins the election or not. Opinion.

flash_694741.description:
As part of discussions over Benny Gantz potentially joining the Likud party, he was reportedly offered a ministerial position in the current government as a gesture intended to strengthen the "national unity government" campaign, Kan News reported.

Likud stated that "Benny Gantz has not received an offer of a reserved spot on the party's electoral list."

The Blue and White party stated that Gantz is not interested in "jobs, honors, or reserved spots," and that the only relevant option from its perspective is the establishment of a Zionist government spanning political blocs.

flash_694740.description: Yaakov Hagoel,Chairman World Zionist Organization, denounced the decision of the UK Green Party equating Zionism with racism. "The Green Party of England and Wales's decision to adopt a resolution defining Zionism as racism is a shameful, scandalous resolution tainted with severe Antisemitism."

flash_694738.description:
Earlier today (Sunday), the IDF struck in the Khan Yunis area in the Gaza Strip and eliminated Muad Gamal Abu Nuseira, a commander in Hamas’ military wing.

Yesterday (Saturday), in an additional strike, the IDF eliminated Mahmoud Ibrahim Dib Alyan, a terrorist in Hamas’ observation unit.

Recently, the terrorist was identified advancing terrorist activities against IDF troops in the area of the Yellow Line and working to restore Hamas’ capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire agreement. The terrorist was eliminated in an aerial strike.

flash_694737.description: Israeli officials say the copilot planned to strike Ben Gurion Airport’s terminal during landing; Channel 13 reports he chose Flydubai because it flew to Tel Aviv.

flash_694736.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu instructed National Security Council chief Shmuel Ben-Ezra to appoint an investigator to conduct a thorough review of all security aspects of foreign civilian aviation to Israel.

flash_694734.description: A soldier’s quick reaction prompted the evacuation of a bus packed with Givati troops just moments before it caught fire at a southern Israel base.

flash_694732.description: Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir announces conclusion of October 7 investigations, warns Israel's enemies of preemptive strikes, and calls for expanding the IDF to confront multi-front threats.

flash_694730.description: The government is expected to approve an extension of the special emergency on the home front at its meeting on Tuesday, amid ongoing security tensions, through October 20.

flash_694726.description: About 100 protesters gathered outside Sag Harbor Cinema, while the IAC urged future screenings to include survivor testimony and context.

flash_694724.description:
Amcha Yisrael chairman Ofer Winter commented on an old video in which the party's number two candidate, Yoseph Haddad, is heard expressing support for the establishment of a Palestinian state.

"I am proud of Yoseph Haddad, a Golani soldier who was wounded in combat in Lebanon and is Israel's strongest advocate," Winter said.

He added: "I am proud of a person's ability to change his positions in the right direction. Some people look at the past; we learn from the past to correct the future."

flash_694722.description: Less than a month before Election Day, Uri Geller predicts the outcome, while making his own position clear: 'There’s no one like Bibi.'

flash_694718.description: Ta’al chairman argues that Yair Golan’s party’s support for disqualifying Sami Abu Shehadeh was a move reflecting the party’s character, calling it 'a serious mistake from a democratic standpoint.'

flash_694716.description: Border Police caught three suspects loading €100,000 worth of copper coils into a pickup truck. They were released with the vehicle and loot, then rearrested the next day - but the coils were gone.

flash_694754.description: A short while ago, IDF soldiers identified a suspect attempting to infiltrate an IDF post in the Security Zone in southern Syria. Following a quick identification, the soldiers fired toward the suspect and eliminated him. No IDF injuries were reported.

flash_694753.description: WZO delegation head Matan Bar Noy tore up the Green Party resolution outside Parliament, invoking Chaim Herzog’s 1975 protest against the UN’s 'Zionism is racism' vote.

flash_694752.description: Police issue six-month restraining order against Temple Mount activist Yehuda Glick, banning him from holy site. Claims it was due to prayers for wounded reservist.

flash_694750.description:
Yashar! Chairman Gadi Eisenkot invited Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to a public televised debate to be broadcast live across all media channels.

Eisenkot called on Netanyahu to provide the public with direct answers regarding the events of October 7 and proposed that the debate format, moderators, and allocation of speaking time be determined by mutual agreement between the two sides.

flash_694749.description: Amcha Yisrael falls below the threshold for the first time in a Kan News poll, leaving Eisenkot’s bloc with 52 seats to Netanyahu’s 51.

flash_694747.description: As we begin reading the Torah from Bereishit, we pause to contemplate what its roots are.

flash_694745.description: Joshua Bell’s Violin-and the Music of Jewish History.

flash_694742.description:
Bursts of gunfire were heard on Sunday evening near a conference in Rahat attended by Ra'am candidate Yoav Segalovitz, a former Deputy Minister of Public Security. The shooting occurred against the backdrop of a dispute between clans in the city.

Segalovitz said: "During the gathering, bursts of gunfire were heard very close to us, in the early evening hours. What is inconceivable is that here in the city, this has almost become routine."

flash_694739.description: The UAE reportedly shared the flight’s passenger and crew information with Israel before takeoff, raising fresh questions over how the alleged cockpit attacker was allowed to board.

flash_694735.description: Australian police are examining Hamam al-Hammami’s ties to the country, including his years as a student, after the attempted crash of a Dubai-Tel Aviv flight.

flash_694733.description: Alongside his activities within the Hamas terrorist organization, Saqr Qaisi served as the director of the Turkish organization Deniz Feneri.

flash_694757.description: IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir honors Unit 8200 CWO who warned before October 7 that Hamas was preparing a large-scale surprise attack.

flash_694756.description: Flavio Bolsonaro leads Brazil's President Lula with 48.47% of the vote as results come in, meaning a runoff will take place on October 25.

flash_694755.description: The US has withdrawn all bombers from RAF Fairford in England after commanders received new threats about a suspected Iran-backed plot targeting the base.

flash_694751.description: An NSC probe will examine a series of warnings, missed intelligence and unresolved responsibility questions that allowed the hijacker to fly to Israel.

flash_694748.description: Ireland’s players lowered their heads during Hatikvah and refused the customary handshake as political tensions overshadowed their latest Nations League meeting with Israel.

flash_694746.description: A march marking the 1936 stand against fascists in Jewish east London drew chants excluding Zionists, as Jewish groups fought to reclaim their place in its history.

flash_694731.description: Israel will establish an embassy in Kinshasa, the capital of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as the Congolese government prepares to move its embassy in Israel to Jerusalem.

flash_694771.description: Combat Antisemitism Movement denounces UK Green Party’s resolution equating Zionism with racism, warning it stigmatizes Jewish communities, turns anti-racism into vehicle for anti-Jewish discrimination.

flash_694770.description: Beitar fans visited more than 60 graves of club supporters murdered on October 7, bringing candles, prayers and a promise: 'You will always be part of the Beitar family.'

flash_694769.description: Police arrest three daycare assistants after 11-month-old arrives at hospital with ear injury.

flash_694767.description: Footage from Soroka Medical Center reveals the first 24 hours of October 7 from the perspective of the medical teams on duty.

flash_694765.description: IDF's General Staff holds memorial ceremony, moment of silence, at 6:29 a.m. Monday morning, honoring victims of October 7 massacre.

flash_694763.description: Yashar chairman Gadi Eisenkot formally invites Netanyahu to a live televised debate: “The public deserves answers without spins and lies."

flash_694761.description: IDF Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir marked three years since October 7, vowing to learn its lessons, strengthen the military and protect Israeli civilians.

flash_694759.description: In a podcast, former hostage Romi Gonen reveals footage of herself being taken to Gaza: “I wake up with it in the morning and go to sleep with it at night."

flash_694806.description: A British court sentenced a man of Kuwaiti origin to life in prison after he attempted to break into the Israeli Embassy in London last year and carry out a stabbing attack.

flash_694805.description: The Shin Bet chief told Cabinet ministers that he may demand the reinstatement of administrative detention against Jewish extremists.

flash_694804.description: President Herzog told Fox News the Flydubai attack exposed serious security gaps and warned that Iran must never gain access to nuclear capabilities.

flash_694802.description: Former White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt will join Fox News as an on-air contributor, offering political commentary beginning November 1.

flash_694800.description: Hours after the stabbing attack and vehicle arson at a farm in Binyamin ended miraculously without casualties, new footage reveals the dramatic moments of the incident.

flash_694798.description: Former senior Shin Bet official: Ronen Bar had the intelligence regarding Hamas’s preparations but he was operating under the 'conceptzia.'

flash_694796.description: State ceremony at Mount Herzl honors those murdered in the October 7 massacre and the acts of heroism by civilians and security forces during the Hamas attack.

flash_694794.description: Father of Tom Godo, who was killed by friendly fire in massacre aftermath, interrupts Netanyahu’s memorial address, accusing him of failing October 7 victims.

flash_694792.description: London police are deploying hundreds of officers as pro-Palestinian marches are planned for October 7 and 10, with strict conditions and arrests threatened.

flash_694790.description: MK Meir Porush says United Torah Judaism to veto coalition posts and coalition legislation until acceptable Draft Law passes.

flash_694788.description: Man in the audience shouts, 'You don’t deserve to lay a wreath,' as Supreme Court President Yitzhak Amit approaches during state memorial ceremony at Mount Herzl.

flash_694786.description:
A terrorist attempted to carry out a stabbing attack at the Hananya Farm near Geva Binyamin.

The terrorist was neutralized at the scene. No one was injured.

Large numbers of forces are being sent to the scene, and the incident is under investigation.

flash_694784.description: State ceremony at Mount Herzl honors those murdered in the October 7 massacre and the acts of heroism by civilians and security forces during the Hamas attack.

flash_694782.description: Kamari Retail Group to acquire 50% of Zalman’s for NIS 3.5 million as kosher fast-food chain plans to grow to about 40 branches nationwide.

flash_694780.description:
Speaking at the state memorial ceremony for IDF soldiers and members of the security forces who fell in the Swords of Iron War, PM Netanyahu centered his remarks on Israel’s response since October 7 and the sacrifices made by soldiers fighting on multiple fronts.

He highlighted the weakening of Israel’s enemies and presented the war as a struggle for the country’s survival and long-term security, stressing that Hamas must not regain control of Gaza and that Israel must retain the ability to prevent another October 7.

Read More

flash_694779.description:
Following a report recived a short while ago regarding an attempted ramming attack in the area of Bani Naim, IDF soldiers operating in the area identified a vehicle carrying three suspects that was driving suspiciously. The vehicle then accelerated toward an IDF vehicle and hit it.

No IDF injuries were reported.

In response, the soldiers responded by firing toward the vehicle, and hits were identified.

flash_694777.description: IDF units across all sectors held simultaneous memorial ceremonies at 6:29 a.m., the time the October 7 massacre began, lowering flags to half-mast and honoring the fallen.

flash_694820.description:
Hundreds of haredi protesters gathered overnight outside the home of a draft evader in Modi’in to protest his arrest.

The protesters attempted to break into the draft evader's apartment building. Following clashes between the protesters and police at the scene, the draft evader was released.

flash_694819.description: Saudi-led forces launch an operation in Yemen as government troops battle the Iran-backed Houthis, who claim missile and drone attacks on Saudi targets.

flash_694818.description:
A 35-year-old man was moderately injured while riding an electric scooter on Dizengoff Street in Tel Aviv.

Magen David Adom (MDA) teams provided him with medical treatment before evacuating him to Ichilov Hospital in the city.

flash_694816.description: Watch the special broadcast from Kan 11: Chilling footage from Soroka Hospital on October 7th revealed for the first time, alongside the heroic battle of the medical staff to save lives.

flash_694814.description: Former hostage Avinatan Or says he opposed a deal that could lead to future abductions: “It was clear to me that Israel needed to emerge victorious from this war."

flash_694812.description: Trump: I think Iran is responsible for attempted hijacking of Flydubai plane

flash_694810.description: Urban warfare expert Jonathan Spencer accuses documentary of spreading “lies, lies by omission, and lies of ignorance," takes particular aim at claim that Israel killed more than 73,000 in Gaza.

flash_694808.description: Hamam al-Hammami, suspected of attempting to crash the Flydubai plane told investigators that he wanted to “die as a shahid."

flash_694803.description:
Defense Minister Israel Katz said that of the 6,000 terrorists who crossed the border into Israel on October 7, 2023, 4,000 have been eliminated so far and 2,000 remain.

According to him, the directive to the IDF and other security forces is to pursue and eliminate them.

Katz added that beyond the goal of dismantling Hamas and demilitarizing the Gaza Strip, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's and his own directive is "to pursue and eliminate everyone without limit and in any situation, from senior to junior."

flash_694801.description:
President Isaac Herzog addressed the Iranian threat in an interview with Fox News, saying that "Iran is an evil empire that threatens the free world."

Herzog emphasized that "it must not be allowed any access to nuclear capabilities."

flash_694797.description: At the October 7 state memorial, Netanyahu vowed to destroy Hamas’s rule, finish the mission in Gaza, and continue pursuing those responsible for the massacre.

flash_694795.description: Police arrested a Palestinian Arab who filmed himself dumping sewage waste into streams in Judea and Samaria and claimed that this was his way of harming Israeli residents and Israeli territory.

flash_694793.description: A short while ago, IDF soldiers identified two suspects riding a motorcycle towards an IDF post in the Security Zone in southern Syria. Following identification, the soldiers opened a suspect apprehension procedure and apprehended the two suspects. No IDF injuries were reported.

flash_694791.description: Military Intelligence Directorate chief Shlomi Binder told the Cabinet that 4,000 of the 6,000 terrorists who participated in the massacre have been eliminated. The hunt for the remainder continues.
